newsitem.title: ITALY: Italmobiliare 1996 profits and div up.
newsitem.headline: Italmobiliare 1996 profits and div up.

text.p: Italian investment holding group Italmobiliare on Wednesday reported 1996 net consolidated attributable profit of 39.7 billion lire after 1995's 34.2 billion lire.

The group added in a statement that its 1996 net consolidated profits were 130 billion lire after 129.8 billion lire in 1995, on 1996 sales down 6.6 percent at 5.554 trillion lire from 1995's 5.984 trillion lire.

At the parent company level, Italmobiliare SpA reported 1996 net profits of 30.7 billion lire after 27.3 billion lire while the company increased its dividend on ordinary shares to 600 lire from 530 lire a share and on savings shares to 750 lire from 680 lire a share.
